description: Cite-or-abstain ledger for the BOS (new nature / forest planting) NormCard corpus. Evidence items that failed the verification gate are listed under rejectedEvidence (none in the bos shard: all 5 records were verified against the consolidated CVDR704250 text). Topics for which NO provincial norm could be cited for the forest_planting object type are recorded under abstentions — these must never appear as NormCards or FormalRules until a verified citation exists.
policy: cite-or-abstain: a legal claim becomes a NormCard only with instrument + article + version/date + verbatim quote + URL, all verified. Everything else is recorded here with a reason.

abstentions.topic: stikstof (nitrogen deposition) constraints for nature/forest development
abstentions.reason: The Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht contains no provincial nitrogen articles (verified in the wind recon, A-01); nitrogen rules are national law (PAS/programmatic approach). National instruments were not fetched in this recon run, so no citation exists — abstained.

abstentions.topic: NNN addition procedure after realisation of new nature
abstentions.reason: The B-01 notes record that realised new nature is added to the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, but the addition procedure itself is not an omgevingsverordening article in this shard; no verified citation exists — abstained as a procedural topic.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: procedural rule describing the NNN addition process

abstentions.topic: land acquisition, area processes and financing of new nature
abstentions.reason: The realisation of new nature runs through voluntary conversion, land acquisition and area processes governed by provincial policy documents and the Natuurbeheerplan — not by verified verordening articles in this corpus — abstained.

Which nature/forest types may be realised where is determined by the Natuurbeheerplan (maatgevend per the B-02 notes) and ecological site assessment, not by a verordeningsnorm — no citable provincial article exists, abstained.

The DSO Omgevingsdocumenten Downloaden API returned HTTP 401 'Inloggegevens ontbreken' (verified in the wind recon, A-06) — an API key is mandatory and none is available. The Groene contour and oude bosgroeiplaatsen GIO join-ids are cited from the consolidated CVDR text (Bijlage II) only; geometry comes from the provincial agrest alias with provenance caveats.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: authoritative geometry for the FR-B-01/FR-B-03 zoneSelectors

abstentions.reason: A major amendment is expected: PS vaststelling 18-11-2026, inwerkingtreding 01-01-2027 (verified in the wind recon, A-08). Its rules are NOT current law; the bos corpus must re-run the legal recon before that date.
